All 143 tests pass now (1 skipped). The fix was adding the three missing argument definitions (`--unstable`, `--line-ranges`, and `--no-preview-line-length-1`) to the `get_flags_parser()` function in `tests/util.py`.

**Summary:** The `get_flags_parser()` function in `tests/util.py` was missing three argparse argument definitions that were referenced in `parse_mode()`:
- `--unstable` (used for `black.Mode(unstable=...)`)
- `--line-ranges` (used for parsing line ranges)
- `--no-preview-line-length-1` (used for `TestCaseArgs`)

These were added after the existing `--fast` argument definition.
